body:
Core2 duty reads now have public `mori check` coverage with a complete 15-node compiler-output expectation. The fixture covers duty reads in `Require`, `Let`, `Await.guard`, and `Next` without executing either action.

This is the six-path main integration of the source coverage originally proposed in #254, based on #255. Five fixture/test files retain their original bytes; the documentation adds only the seven duty-read lines to the current main guidance.

Local validation: one Rust integration test passed; both public CLI processes exited successfully with exact expected stdout/stderr; the complete compiler output matched the frozen JSON. All 891 post-test source pins match commit `caa416f52b23fc1709d83d2c93794e1af4b79846`. This is source-check evidence; action execution, proofs, and ledger acceptance remain open. Fresh source/result review is pending.
title: Cover Core2 duty reads on the main integration branch
